post.message: Standing in a Miami garage in July tells you everything about an uninsulated door: it bakes all afternoon, and that heat slides toward the rooms next to it. Insulation can take the edge off, but it won't turn the garage into a cooled room, and it matters more for some homes than others. West-facing door, attached garage, a gym or home office out there? Worth a closer look. We put together what to ask before you pick a door, so you can compare estimates side by side.
